newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mth T-bill yields fall,12-mth rise.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-,6-,9-mth T-bill yields fall,12-mth rise.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills sharply fell to 30.65 percent from 43.09 percent at the last sale on October 17, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows: Auction Number 203 199
Amount sold 5.00 million UAH 6.00 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.65 million UAH 5.42 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 50,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 1,076 were competitive and 48,924 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for October 29.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills edged down to 47.44 percent from 49.20 percent at the last sale on October 17.
Results of Tuesday's six-month auction vs last issue: Auction Number 204 200
Amount sold 8.44 million UAH 9.01 million UAH
Actual amount raised 6.83 million UAH 7.24 million UAH
The central bank sold 84,442 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 22,079 were competitive and 62,363 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills slipped to 58.20 percent from 59.76 percent at the last sale on October 17.
Results of Tuesday's nine-month auction vs last: Auction Number 205 201
Amount sold 4.614 million UAH 2.898 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.215 million UAH 2.003 million UAH
The central bank sold 46,143 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 8,950 were competitive and 37,193 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is unfixed.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged up to 61.20 percent from 60.86 percent at the last sale on October 17.
Results of Tuesday's 12-month auction vs last issue: Auction Number 206 202
The central bank sold 2,596 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 153 were competitive and 2,443 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is unfixed. --Kiev newsroom +380 44 229-2264
